offering_description.value: UMB Financial is a Kansas City-based bank holding company offering commercial banking, institutional banking, personal banking and wealth management. It also provides specialty services such as healthcare payment accounts, fund administration and custody, and corporate trust to businesses, institutions and individuals.

primary_products.value: commercial loans; deposit accounts; credit and payment cards; health savings accounts; mortgage and consumer loans

primary_services.value: commercial banking; wealth management and trust; fund administration and custody; corporate trust and escrow; healthcare payment processing

customer_segment.value: B2B: commercial businesses, asset managers, fund sponsors, healthcare employers and benefit plan sponsors, bond issuers; B2C: individuals and families for personal banking, wealth management and HSAs; B2G: municipalities and public entities for treasury services and public finance

end_markets.value: banking and financial services; asset management; healthcare benefits; public finance; commercial real estate

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: net interest income on loans and securities; service fees: trust, custody, fund administration, wealth management and treasury management fees; transaction or usage fees: card interchange, HSA and payment processing fees, deposit service charges
revenue_model.category: interest or premiums; service fees; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: takes in deposits, lends to businesses and consumers, and provides trust, custody and payment services

geography_served.value: US national: Banking branches in Missouri, Kansas, Colorado, Oklahoma, Texas, Arizona, Nebraska, Illinois and Indiana, institutional and HSA services nationwide

specialization.value: related lines: commercial banking, personal banking and wealth management, institutional fund services, and healthcare payments

distribution_channels.value: own locations: bank branches across the Midwest and Southwest; direct sales: relationship managers for commercial, institutional and wealth clients; online: online and mobile banking and HSA enrollment; partners / resellers: employer and benefit-provider partners for HSA accounts
distribution_channels.category: own locations; direct sales; online; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: chartered bank and holding company supervised by the Federal Reserve, OCC, FDIC, CFPB and SEC for trust and fund services

notes: Branch state list and exact business segment mix are from memory and may be slightly outdated.
